additional_info.subject: Urgent: MP/R0 170002548
additional_info.body:
Dear all.
Due to a malfunction in my ticket system, I am writing an email.
We have an
urgent customer escalation
:
Charger ID:  DE-MBT-EAH5057DC002-2 / MP/R0 170002548
Location: An der Autobahn 1, 07589, Lederhose, DEU
Charging date : 06.01.2026 / 20.00 o'clock
Issue Description:
Cable lock issue,
tried to reset station and to unlock the cable but did not work, tried all troubleshoot steps with the customer but did all not work. Tried the emergency release on the car > did not work.
customer called the ADAC but they could also not help him.
car is still connected to the charger and will stay there probably overnight, customer needs help urgently
Could you please analyse the diagnostics in detail from 6 January 2025 at approximately 7 p.m.?
The customer's vehicle has been inextricably connected to the cable since the day before yesterday and cannot be disconnected. It is suspected that the cable has come loose from the plug. A technician is urgently needed so that the vehicle can be towed to a car repair.
Please find the pictures in the attachment and let me know how to proceed.
Thank you and kind regards
Alexandra Becker

Go on-site with replacement cable.
Take charger off grid;
